title: Work Record
description: The durable artefact a dialogue produces (ADR-050): observations, proposals, open questions, goals, limits and acceptance criteria, readable and revisable BEFORE any repository is chosen and BEFORE any GitHub issue exists. A work record therefore never requires an issue_ref or a repository; the store envelope's issue_ref stays optional. Revision is supersession, never mutation: a changed record is a NEW record appended with supersedes pointing at the earlier one, which stays readable and byte-identical. A work record may be a finished result: state="settled" with no code change, no issue and no Run is a delivery, not an incomplete step toward one. Deliberately absent, and the absence IS the decision: no pinned sha, no permitted effects, no isolation, no limits-on-effects and no write allowlist. Those belong to the frozen packaging revision form and to mandate preparation (ADR-050 D5); do not add them and do not add placeholders for them.

record_kind.description: Discriminator. The Core store holds several domains in one append-only log, so iter_records() must be filtered on this field.

work_id.description: Stable across every revision of one piece of work. The supersession chain of a work is found by this field, never by append order.

state.description: A CONTENT field, not an outcome record: the verdict lives inside the record exactly as the packaging decision slot's verdict does. "settled" says this record is a finished result in its own right.

observations.description: What the dialogue observed. Required, may be empty.

proposals.description: What the dialogue proposes. Required, may be empty.

open_questions.description: What is still undecided. Required, may be empty.

goals.description: What the work is for. Required, may be empty.

limits.description: The operator's scope boundaries for this work. Required, may be empty.

acceptance_criteria.description: What would make this work accepted. Required, may be empty.

possibly_affected_repositories.description: The MIDDLE of the product's three levels — available context, POSSIBLY AFFECTED REPOSITORIES, approved change targets — and the middle one only. Free-text names or paths as surfaced by discovery. It carries NO sha, NO permission, NO effect and NO ordering, and it MUST NEVER be read as a change target: discovery and read access never grant write access. An approved change target is a separate, later, operator-approved artefact. Required, may be empty.
